description: Times packed FP16 FMA work at the recorded grid geometry. The declared sweep uses one block. Emits raw GPU time and workload descriptors; qualified packed-FMA throughput is derived downstream and is not a measured whole-device peak.

scaling_param.name: fmas_per_thread
scaling_param.description: Number of __hfma2 operations per thread per kernel invocation; controls total compute work

non_scaling_params.name: num_blocks
non_scaling_params.description: Number of thread blocks (default 1 = single-SM/CU measurement; device peak is derived as per-SM value × SM count)

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: When true, run the untimed vector-add warmer before each timed operation to raise clocks and disturb cache state; qualify the resulting state on the target. False disables the warmer without promising a particular cache state.
